secondaryValue: Never play, Play when relevant, Always play
fieldDescription: Plays a sound when a harpoon charge is restored. 'Play when relevant' limits it to when breach lamps are on or your fleet is near an open pond.
Centers the camera on a pond as it opens for easier aiming. Disable to keep manual camera control. Manual movement may make aiming harder or cause discomfort if you are sensitive to motion.
Adds a Fisherman dialogue option to skip the tutorial before you start it. Has no effect after the tutorial begins.
